description: hexe's single LTX 2.3 video workflow (Nov 11): first frame, or first + last frame (ns_toggle_use_LF), with generated sound or the song as audio in (ns_toggle_use_audio_in), vocals isolated for lip-sync (ns_toggle_isolate_vocals). 3 stages, the INT8 ConvRot model. Inputs are found by their ns_ titles. Both frame loaders always need a real file (ComfyUI checks them even on the unused branch): pass the first frame twice for first-frame-only jobs. Same image as first and last frame = a locked-off camera.
